title: Preserve the double-dash option prefix
prompt: Fix Click's option parser in src/click/parser.py, specifically _split_opt. A long option such as --verbose must be split into the prefix -- and the value verbose. A short option such as -v must still be split into - and v, and an unprefixed value must retain an empty prefix. Keep the change focused and do not change tests.
test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from click.parser import _split_opt; assert _split_opt('--verbose') == ('--', 'verbose'); assert _split_opt('-v') == ('-', 'v'); assert _split_opt('value') == ('', 'value')"

source.mutation: The double-dash branch temporarily returns only the first dash.
